insights.one_liner: Search AI software company behind Elasticsearch, with Dutch roots (Elastic N.V.) but not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: Builds search, observability and security software used by more than half of the Fortune 500.
About 8,508 employees, mostly in engineering and sales; many studied computer science at US universities like UT Austin and Berkeley.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor, so it cannot sponsor a highly skilled migrant visa through the Dutch entity.
The group's parent is Elastic N.V., registered in the Netherlands.

growth.text: Beat expectations and raised its guidance in its latest quarterly results.
Launched a serverless vector database and other AI search products in September 2026.

worth_knowing.text: Elastic Security got the only perfect score in the 2026 AV-Comparatives endpoint prevention and response test.
